title: Smoky Ethiopian Turkey Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ethiopia, slow-cooked with tender turkey neck and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add stew mix, paprika, carrots, potatoes, tomato paste, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
